title: Stage 2a Machine-to-R FD3 two-member pre-Hello delivery (draft)
description: Machine's fixed launcher supplies the exact A-signed one-use v3 reservation and #85 member-set assignment before R sends Hello. H selects an A-authenticated start but cannot create or replace either envelope. R independently reads the fixed root:wheel 0444 raw A Ed25519 pin, verifies both signatures and exact JCS bytes, rederives the measured eight-field two-member projection and joins the reservation/plan/start. Legacy runner FD3 versions remain unchanged. This frame does not grant provider ingress or physical qualification.
